name: codepilot-ai
description: CodePilot AI — Your AI-Powered Programming Companion

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w client && playwright test
